import Mathlib.Data.String.Cardinal.Set
import Mathlib.Data.String.List

def countDigits (s : String) : Nat :=
  s.length - List.length (List.filter isDigit s.toList)

theorem countDigits_spec_satisfied (s : String) (h_precond : countDigits_precond (s)) :
  countDigits_postcond (s) (countDigits (s) h_precond) h_precond := by
  apply countDigits_spec_satisfied
